Issuance is refused when the principal cannot be verified — that refusal is what makes the ID worth anything. PO

tools.description: Use agentid_verify when you want to check an Agent ID's current standing: valid, revoked, expired, or unknown. tools.name: agentid_revoke
tools.description: Use agentid_revoke to retire an Agent ID instantly. revocation_signature: hex signature over the message agent-id-revoke:<agent_id> (64-char lowercase ID). EIP-191: personal_sign the message string (envelope required; raw ECDSA fails), 0x 65-byte hex, matched to the principal's revocation key. ed255

tools.name: agentid_renew

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_recovery, verified_check, prove_it, proveit_verified_check, preflight_check, compute_alerts, assurance_check, agentid_verify, give, compute_spot_prices · Private data: research_paper, agentid_verify, cert · Public sink: register_recovery, verified_check, prove_it, proveit_verified_check, trust_report, preflight_check, compute_history, compute_alerts, research_paper, assurance_check, agentid_issue, agentid_verify, agentid_revoke, agentid_renew, correct_copy, give.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_recovery, verified_check, prove_it, proveit_verified_check, preflight_check, compute_alerts, assurance_check, agentid_verify, give, compute_spot_prices · Private data: research_paper, agentid_verify, cert · Public sink: register_recovery, verified_check, prove_it, proveit_verified_check, trust_report, preflight_check, compute_history, compute_alerts, research_paper, assurance_check, agentid_issue, agentid_verify, agentid_revoke, agentid_renew, correct_copy, give

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
